contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ [?DN] CONSTAN S PF AVG ; R/ [GLORIA EXERCITVS]

Copper alloy coin. Nummus, probably of Constans (333-350), Gloria Exercitus issue of 335-341, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Bust probably laureate cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: [?DN] CONSTAN S PF AVG. Reverse description: Two soldiers with one standard between them. Reverse inscription: [GLORIA EXERCITVS]. In exergue: [looks like] [-]IV. Diameter: 15.0mm, Weight: 1.89gms, die axis: 6
